label: Completed Akhlaki-Nasiri
description: Tusi completed work on the treatise Nasirean ethics at the request of the ruler of Kuhistan.

sources.quote: In 1235, Tusi completed work on the treatise "Nasirean ethics (Akhlaki-Nasiri)", which he began to write at the request of the ruler of Kuhistan, which will be discussed below.

label: Imprisoned in Alamut fortress
description: Relations between the ruler and Tusi were strained, in connection with which in the same year Tusi was arrested and imprisoned in the Alamut fortress.

sources.quote: By the end of the work, relations between the ruler and Tusi were strained, in connection with which in the same year Tusi was arrested and imprisoned in the Alamut fortress.

label: Freed by Hulagu Khan
description: Hulagu Khan took the Alamut fortress and freed Nasir al-Din al-Tusi.

sources.quote: In 1256 Hulagu Khan took the Alamut fortress and freed Nasir al-Din al-Tusi.

label: Founded Maragheh Observatory
description: A colossal historical merit of the scientist is the founding of an astronomical observatory in the city of Maragha.

sources.quote: A colossal historical merit of the scientist is the founding of an astronomical observatory in the city of Maragha (1259–1260)

label: Completed Zij Ilkhani
description: The result of 12-year observations of the Maragha astronomers was the Ilkhanic Tables.

sources.quote: The result of 12 -year (from 1259 to 1271) observations of the Maragha astronomers was the "Ilkhanic Tables (Zij Ilkhani)".

label: Died in Baghdad
description: In 672, Nasir al-Din al-Tusi went to Baghdad... In the same year, he fell ill in Baghdad and died of illness.

sources.quote: In 672, Nasir al -Din al-Tusi went to Baghdad accompanied by his friends and mentors. In the same year, he fell ill in Baghdad and died of illness.
